summary: iteration_49: Backend-only regression for the RDP reseller API, admin golden status, and the DO golden build unit suite. All 11 pytest tests PASS (11/11 = 100%): auth-required on plans and create, /rdp/plans returns 12 plans and 3 os_options with correct fast_deploy flags/regions for US/EU/SG (ws2019+ws2022 fast_deploy=true eta=3min US+EU in fast_deploy_regions; ws2025 fast_deploy=false eta=45 empty regions), POST /rdp validates invalid_plan and invalid_os (message lists ws2019/ws2022/ws2025) before billing, GET /rdp returns rdp array, /api/provision/bootscript returns text/plain PowerShell containing all 4 expected needles, and /api/admin/rdp-golden/status with correct key returns ws2019 available image 246589188 fast_deploy true, ws2022 available image 246587962 fast_deploy true, ws2025 building active_build_id build-6f59c03d1260 with builds[] entry phase=importing; wrong key -> 401. Node unit suite `node js/tests/test_do_rdp_golden_2026-06.js` = 66 passed, 0 failed. `bash -n js/rdp-scripts/convert_to_windows.sh` exit 0. No mutating endpoints were called; no droplets/orders created.

minor.issue: os_options[] entries do not surface the active build's `phase` (e.g. importing/registering); consumers must join with builds[] by active_build_id. Not a bug per current contract, but a small UX improvement for admin dashboards.

critical_code_review_comments: listOsOptions() correctly emits fast_deploy_regions as reseller region codes; ws2025 kept at fast_deploy=false is the expected state until DO finishes the import (build-6f59c03d1260, phase=importing).
vpsCreateHandler validates invalid_plan and invalid_os before any billing/DO call — verified by tests (no droplet was created).

provisionServer() now loads per-order admin_password from the secret store before building user-data (fix confirmed by the 66-assertion node unit suite: fast-path user-data carries the real password; slow-path autounattend bakes the real password).
